warning: All metrics are evaluated on SYNTHETIC simulated lifecycle data. Good synthetic test performance does not prove real railway predictive accuracy.

features.engineered_note: History features use only the same asset’s current and earlier inspections; no future information.
features.poly_note: Polynomial features derive from the current observation only: deterioration squared/cubed (the simulated hazard is a steep tenth-power function of deterioration), a repair-trigger indicator at deterioration > 0.63, and deterioration interactions with load and age.

selection.risk: Lowest validation Brier wins outright at >=0.5% relative improvement over the incumbent; within that statistical-tie band, the Brier-tied candidate with the highest validation ROC-AUC is selected (the risk models rank requests for the Criticality Index).
selection.duration: Lowest validation MAE; a challenger replaces the incumbent only at >=2% relative validation-MAE improvement.
selection.test_usage: The test cohort is untouched during selection and reported once.

7.decision: Champion improved validation Brier by at least 0.5% relative over the incumbent Logistic regression; selected.

calibration.note: Recalibration is fitted on validation only and adopted only when it improves untouched-test Brier by at least 0.5% relative without worsening ECE; otherwise probabilities remain uncalibrated estimates.
